function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways, 35 mph on city streets.
• “No speed limit” zones exist in some rural areas. | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is illegal (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is prohibited. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02 % BAC). | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Stop signs and traffic signals must be obeyed. | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Must remain stopped until the bus’s stop sign is retracted. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Passing on the right is prohibited unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Parking on a curb is allowed only if the curb is not marked. | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Vehicles must be towed if they are a hazard or have been abandoned.
• Towing laws vary by county; check local ordinances. | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must display a valid registration sticker.
• Minimum liability insurance is required. | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Speed cameras are used in many counties; fines are issued automatically. | | **Roadside Assistance & Emergency** | • 911 for emergencies.
• Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) provides roadside assistance for registered vehicles. | ### Where to Find the Full Text - **Texas Transportation Code** – Chapter 545 (Traffic Rules) and Chapter 545.1 (Traffic Safety). - **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Official website has downloadable PDFs of the Texas Transportation Code. - **Texas Legislature Online** – Search for “Transportation Code” for the most recent amendments. ### Quick Resources - **TxDMV Traffic Rules PDF**: https://www.txdmv.gov/sites/default/files/2024/01/txdmv-traffic-rules.pdf - **TxDOT Traffic Safety**: https://www.txdot.gov/traffic-safety.html - **Texas Legislature Online**: https://capitol.texas.gov/ Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to interpret a particular section!
